integrity: The general theorem is proved by exact counting, symmetry and the conductance-tilt identity. Finite exact-rational enumeration is supporting consistency evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Single modified edge in K_{a,b} with a,b>=2; only cross-part leaf covariances. No multi-edge perturbation or noncomplete graph classification.
title: Rank-one checkerboard leaf correlations under a single bipartite edge tilt
